slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When the aircraft flies to a target carrying a bomb, does it drop that single bomb on the target and then return to the airport, meaning each bombing run uses exactly one bomb?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each bombing run carries exactly one bomb, directly covering the per-trip carrying capacity constraint.

slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to maximize the probability that at least two of the four key parts are destroyed, or is it to guarantee (with certainty) that at least two parts are destroyed?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and confirmed it is maximizing the probability that at least two key parts are destroyed.
